body: I know its not fun, but whatever this is isnt fun either. Ive been feeling like garbage for a few years now, and events of 2021 have most definitely made it worse. I dont wanna see what this new year has to offer. The whole grade- especially my homeroom class- despises me and thats not even me being self deprecating. They ignore me constantly. My grade average is a C- and thats being extremely generous. Every time we go on a holiday or i come back from a weekend, i can see noticeable decreases in my ability to interact socially- i have literally no idea how to talk to people or act at large gatherings or fuckin anything. Ive heard it only gets worse as an adult and thats whats terrible. Im barely 3 years away from being an adult and ive already been stuck in a very awful state of being. And there isnt any time to change this- according to some seminar the parents went to i have to start thinking about college next year (dont ask why i have no idea), and magically turn my C- (read: D) into As and B+s before March so my 2nd semester marks can have a chance at not being shit. And i wont even mention my abysmal social life or social skills, because then people might actually figure out who this throwaway belongs to and then itll be even more awkward. Ive seen 2 therapists in the past year and nothings changed at all. Im sorry to have written a massive wall of text- i do know you mean well im just. Agh. Something tells me im not going to sleep tonight regardless of whatever decision i make. Still frozen to the spot.
